nodes.label: Fractal One-Way Layered Architecture (L0-L4)
nodes.rationale: Layers only read downward (L0 foundation -> L1 pivots -> L2 lines -> L3 conclusions -> L4 zones) to prevent circular dependencies; rebuild proceeds one testable change per cycle, verified against manual chart analysis before proceeding.

nodes.label: Core Rules Without Inputs Principle
nodes.rationale: Essential strategy rules must not be toggleable inputs; thresholds are ratios of wave amplitude, no foreign indicators and no magic numbers, so strategy fidelity is preserved.

nodes.label: Strategy Fidelity Supreme Principle
nodes.rationale: Strategy faithfulness above all: no foreign indicators (ATR/RSI) unless derived from degree structure; what cannot be automated literally is approximated faithfully, never contradicted.

nodes.label: Layer 1: Peaks and Troughs per Degree
Golden Rule: No Layer Reads From a Higher Layer
nodes.rationale: Any layer reading from a layer above it constitutes a circular dependency and is forbidden; any solution requiring an upward read must stop and be reported, not implemented.

nodes.label: Direction Source Ruling (Wave Boundary, Not Lines)
nodes.rationale: Historical wave direction comes from wave boundaries (Layer 0), fixed inside the wave; each degree's extraction direction is its own structure break within the boundary; liquidity/level lines feed conclusions only - lines are a result, not a cause.

nodes.label: *ExtrDir Repeatable Extraction-Direction Pattern
nodes.rationale: For each degree D above a smaller degree d: an isolated var DExtrDir flips before extraction when an effective d-point breaks D's structure by body; extraction reads DExtrDir only, leaving D's side effects (anchoring, line clearing, L09-10) untouched. Triggered by the smaller degree, so it is available before the larger degree emerges, breaking the chicken-and-egg cycle.

nodes.label: Lesson-by-Lesson Comparison: edde4dd v1.32 vs v3.93.9
nodes.rationale: Verdict: v3.93.9 is more complete and faithful to the lessons in nearly every layer; porting lessons 1-11 from v1.32 would be a regression losing whole rule sets (third effectiveness law, medium pair, big renewal, no-fabrication conclusions, anchor exemption).

nodes.label: useBigBreak Toggle (Break Path vs Leg Path)
okAmp Amplitude Threshold (bigMinATR*ATR vs legMinRatio*ampHist)
nodes.rationale: Risk noted: if ampHist is large or na the ratio threshold collapses and legs get suppressed; v1.32 used ATR-based okAmp instead.

nodes.label: Surgical Leg Restore Recommendation (Two Lines, Not a Port)
nodes.rationale: The beloved v1.32 leg behavior = leg path as default (useBigBreak=false) + ATR okAmp threshold; restoring it is a two-line surgical change that recovers old behavior without losing new work, since the leg engine itself is ~98% identical.

nodes.label: Gap D1: Extraction Direction Source
nodes.rationale: After four failed per-degree transitional direction mechanisms (lagging medActiveDir, circular liquidity slope, medExtrDir structure break, state reset), the final decision fixed medium extraction direction to the stable historical-wave bigDir (fallback largeDir); corrections are handled by peak/trough breaks inside feedMedPair, not direction flips.

nodes.label: Gap D2: Direction Reversal and Level Transfer (Lesson 09)
nodes.rationale: Level-line break = end of that degree's wave; flip the degree direction and move its line to the nearest same-degree peak/trough per the new direction. Deferred to lesson 09 (pivot renewal); it is the final determinant of each degree's direction.

nodes.label: Gap D4: Medium Correction Cleanliness
nodes.rationale: No small arrows/pivots inside a medium correction; the agreed correct fix is not a separate delete feature but a natural consequence of applying effectiveness to the small degree (gap 05-A), so D4 closes automatically when 05-A is decided.

nodes.label: Gap 05-A: Full Effectiveness on Small Degree
Per-Degree Level-Line Direction Rule
nodes.rationale: Each of the three degrees gets its own independent level line drawn on effective pivots' candle bodies at the last peak (downtrend) / last trough (uptrend); price above the degree's level line means the degree is up. Three independent directions may agree or conflict, which is the basis of the conclusions layer.

nodes.label: Approved Documented Deviations (Not Gaps)
nodes.rationale: Ten intentional documented decisions, e.g. stop = entry zone edge (user decision), keepBroken=false (level moves, liquidity erased per lesson 09 literally), no entry without a target zone (conservative faithful interpretation), structural break = two candles only, big-degree extraction by break as default, singleton m.A = target not entry zone, liquidity line drawn without ascending condition (lesson 08 literal), swingMaxDays=10.

nodes.label: Comprehensive Lessons Audit Report (L1+L2 and Review Lectures)
nodes.rationale: Rules are taken from spoken transcript text only; the appended 'my understanding' summaries are fallible helpers; lessons are the primary reference (priority flipped over the older logic doc).

nodes.label: Lesson Numbering Map (Transcript L01-L12 vs Book)
nodes.rationale: Transcript file numbering follows video order of the historical-wave series and does not match the book's lesson numbering (the book merges level-1 and level-2 indices); rules must be tied to content, not number.

nodes.label: Critical Gaps Matrix H1-H16
nodes.rationale: Sixteen decision items that must be resolved before coding, including real source conflicts: H1 level-break threshold (two candles vs one tail), H2 phase-transition trigger (half body vs two candles), H4 extraction break accepts any break vs renewal break needing two candles, H5 confirmation degree (smaller, book wins over L04 wording).

nodes.label: Extraction Break vs Renewal Break vs Phase Transfer Distinction (H4)
nodes.rationale: Extraction break (generating medium/large pivots) accepts any break however small ('it is numbers' - Musab), distinct from renewal/confirmation break (two candles) and phase transfer (half body); conflating them is the root of most confusion.

nodes.label: Confirmation by Smaller Degree Rule (H5)
nodes.rationale: Book + checklist + L01 say confirmation uses one degree smaller (medium confirmed by small, small by fourth); M2_L04's 'third larger degree' wording is judged a naming error - the book's rule is adopted.

nodes.label: LEC_musab2 Transcript (10 Percent Academy, Musab Allam)
Broken Level Transfer Rule (Move, Don't Delete)
nodes.rationale: The broken direction level is transferred, not removed: when a downtrend medium level breaks upward, the line moves to the last trough (and to each new yellow trough), giving the previously user-recorded rule direct spoken-source support (transcript lines 217-219).

nodes.label: Skip Rule (Jump to Step 10 When 3 Degrees Not Found)
Wave Numbering and Fibonacci Plan (Approved)
nodes.rationale: Both features are pure descriptive additions above the indicator: they delete or modify no existing logic, do not touch degree feeding or entry logic; zones and effective points remain governing while numbering and fib are tagged 'approximate' helpers, all derived by rule from existing effective points.

nodes.label: Isolated Standalone Fibonacci Signals (B4, Off by Default)
Wave Test Panel (Frame Fitness, 3 Degrees Exactly)
Four Generalized Effectiveness Laws (f_coveredIn/f_seqEff/f_activated/f_pending)
nodes.rationale: Unified functions applied to any degree by passing its arrays plus direction: coverage is global-forward; sequence and activation are confined to the wave window in its direction; the last unbroken extreme stays a pending candidate.

nodes.label: bigDirLvl (Large Direction State Machine, islast)
nodes.rationale: Large direction flips only in two cases (large-level break by two candles, or medium-level break plus valid blue structure); the old Dow lowerLow/higherHigh rule was removed in v3.85 for flipping on non-effective points, and the direction must stay islast - converting to per-bar previously opened gaps.

nodes.label: Non-Repainting Principle (isconfirmed / islast)
nodes.rationale: All state logic runs inside barstate.isconfirmed so decisions are made at candle close; only live visual drawing repeats at barstate.islast, guaranteeing historical points never repaint.

nodes.label: DegreeLaws Reusable Per-Degree Engine
nodes.rationale: The medium reuses the exact same DegreeLaws engine as the small (feedPivot: sequence + effectiveness + pending + break renewal) as a second instance - no duplicated code; the only new piece is the break engine converting small pivots to raw medium pivots.

nodes.label: Medium Derived by Break, Not by Eye
nodes.rationale: Uptrend: a broken small trough marks a medium correction - highest price before the break = medium peak, lowest after = medium trough (mirror for downtrend); marked with orange circles; last point stays pending until its level breaks.

nodes.label: Spec-First Workflow
nodes.rationale: The full specification (spec_lesson06_medium.md) is written and approved before any code; each subsequent step is one testable change matched against manual chart analysis.
